reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I don't need one more thing I'll quit in two weeks. Nothing here hit a problem I have right now, so no impulse.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone feels like less for the money, and it's made in China.
